title: Reflexive pronouns: herself, himself, themselves
summary: Возвратные местоимения (myself, themselves...): когда нужны, когда нет (wash, relax, next to me), эмфаза, by oneself и отличие от each other.
ru:
## Основное правило и главное отличие от русского
Возвратное местоимение (**myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, oneself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves**) нужно, когда **подлежащее и дополнение — одно и то же лицо**: *She taught herself Spanish. He cut himself shaving.* Формы *hisself* и *theirselves* — просторечие, их не используют.
Но в русском есть привычные «-ся»-глаголы, а в английском для них местоимение чаще всего **не нужно**. Типичная ошибка русскоговорящих:
- ~~I washed myself and dressed myself.~~ → I **washed and dressed**. (мыться, одеваться, бриться)
- ~~She felt herself tired.~~ → She **felt** tired.
- ~~We need to concentrate ourselves.~~ → We need to **concentrate**. (так же *relax, hurry, meet, sit down*)
Местоимение появляется, если действие нужно подчеркнуть: *The toddler can dress himself now* — «одевается сам, без помощи».

## Предлоги места и сопровождения: личное местоимение
После предлогов места (*next to, behind, in front of, around, beside*) и после *with* в значении «при себе» ставим **обычное** местоимение, а не reflexive.
> She put the bag next to **her**. — Она поставила сумку рядом с собой.
> Did you bring your passport with **you**? — Паспорт при тебе?
> He looked behind **him** but saw nobody.
Если же речь о чувствах к самому себе, предлог требует reflexive: *angry with **herself**, proud of **himself**, ashamed of **yourself***.

## Усиление: «сам», «собственной персоной»
Reflexive можно поставить после существительного или в конец предложения — это эмфаза.
> The director **herself** answered the complaint. — Сама директор ответила на жалобу.
> I painted the whole flat **myself**. — Я всё покрасил сам.
**by oneself** = «в одиночестве» или «без чьей-либо помощи»; **on one's own** почти то же самое, но менее эмфатично.
> She lives **by herself** in a small flat. — Она живёт одна.
> The heating switches on **by itself**. — Отопление включается само.

## Устойчивые сочетания
*Help yourself (to the cake)! · Make yourself at home. · Enjoy yourself! · Behave yourself! · Pull yourself together. · Be yourself. · beside oneself (with anger) · in itself · talk to oneself · look after yourself.*
Обратите внимание: *yourself* — к одному человеку, *yourselves* — к нескольким.

## themselves или each other?
Reflexive: каждый действует на самого себя; **each other / one another**: действие взаимное.
> They blamed **themselves** for the accident. — Каждый винил себя.
> They blamed **each other**. — Они обвиняли друг друга.
> Tom and Ann have known **each other** since school.

## Формальные тонкости
*Myself* не заменяет *me* как дополнение: ~~Please contact Ms Lee or myself.~~ → Please contact Ms Lee or **me**. Однако в формальном письме оно допустимо при эмфазе: *As for myself, I would prefer to wait.* Безличное **oneself** (*One should look after oneself*) — очень формально, в обычной речи говорят *you*.
en:
## The basic rule, and where Russian speakers go wrong
Use a reflexive pronoun (**myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, oneself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves**) when the **subject and the object are the same person**: *She taught herself Spanish. He cut himself shaving.* *Hisself* and *theirselves* are non-standard.
Many verbs that are reflexive in Russian are **not** reflexive in English:
- ~~I washed myself and dressed myself.~~ → I **washed and dressed**.
- ~~She felt herself tired.~~ → She **felt** tired.
- ~~We need to concentrate ourselves.~~ → We need to **concentrate**. (also *relax, hurry, meet, sit down*)
A reflexive appears only when you want to stress it: *The toddler can dress himself now* (without help).

## Prepositions of place: ordinary pronouns
After prepositions of place (*next to, behind, in front of, around, beside*) and *with* meaning "carrying", use a **normal** pronoun.
> She put the bag next to **her**.
> Did you bring your passport with **you**?
> He looked behind **him** but saw nobody.
When the idea is feelings about yourself, the reflexive is needed: *angry with **herself**, proud of **himself**, ashamed of **yourself***.

## Emphasis
A reflexive can follow a noun or end the sentence to stress "personally" or "without help".
> The director **herself** answered the complaint.
> I painted the whole flat **myself**.
**by oneself** = alone, or without help; **on one's own** is similar but less emphatic.
> She lives **by herself** in a small flat.
> The heating switches on **by itself**.

## Fixed phrases
*Help yourself (to the cake)! · Make yourself at home. · Enjoy yourself! · Behave yourself! · Pull yourself together. · Be yourself. · beside oneself (with anger) · in itself · talk to oneself · look after yourself.* Use *yourself* for one person, *yourselves* for several.

## themselves or each other?
A reflexive means each person acts on himself; **each other / one another** means the action is mutual.
> They blamed **themselves** for the accident. (each one blamed himself)
> They blamed **each other**.
> Tom and Ann have known **each other** since school.

## Formal points
*Myself* does not replace *me* as an object: ~~Please contact Ms Lee or myself.~~ → Please contact Ms Lee or **me**. It is acceptable for emphasis: *As for myself, I would prefer to wait.* Impersonal **oneself** (*One should look after oneself*) is very formal; people usually say *you*.
structure:
## Формы
| Лицо | Единственное | Множественное |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | myself | ourselves |
| 2 | yourself | yourselves |
| 3 | himself / herself / itself / oneself | themselves |

## Когда что
| Ситуация | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Подлежащее = дополнение | reflexive | She cut herself. |
| Предлог места / with «при себе» | личное местоимение | He put it next to him. |
| Усиление | noun / S + reflexive | The mayor himself came. |
| Без помощи, один | by + reflexive | I did it by myself. |
| Взаимное действие | each other / one another | They hugged each other. |
| «Одевать, мыть, расслабиться» (рутина) | без местоимения | He shaved and dressed. |

## Формулы
> S + V + **reflexive** (S = O)  ·  S + V + O + **reflexive** (эмфаза)
> by + **myself / yourself / himself ...** = alone, without help

exercises.title: Reflexive или обычное местоимение?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее местоимение (reflexive или личное). В подсказке — два варианта.

items.text: Mia was angry with {{herself}} for forgetting the password.
I wasn't badly hurt; I just cut {{myself}} while cooking.
He put the suitcase down next to {{him}} and sighed.
Don't blame {{yourself}}, Peter; it wasn't your fault.
Did you bring your ID with {{you}}?
She looked behind {{her}} but saw nobody there.

exercises.example: She looked at (her / herself) in the mirror. → She looked at **herself** in the mirror.

exercises.title: by, on и each other
exercises.instruction: Вставьте одно слово или форму: по подсказке.

items.text: I fixed the tap all by {{myself}}.
She lives by {{herself}} in a small flat.
Come in and make {{yourself}} at home, Mr Hale.
The door closed by {{itself}} behind us.
We taught {{ourselves}} to code during the lockdown.
Tom and Ann have known {{each other|one another}} since school.
In {{itself}}, the idea is good, but it is far too expensive.

items.q: Mia sat down and put her bag next to ___.
items.why: После предлога места — личное местоимение: **next to her**.
Подлежащее и объект совпадают: **proud of himself**.

items.q: I'd like you to ___ before the interview.
items.why: *Relax* в английском возвратного местоимения не требует.

items.q: The twins trust ___: each is sure the other will help.
I locked ___ out of the flat.
Look after ___, Mum, and call me when you land.
The film ___ is not great, but the soundtrack is superb.
He sat down and spread the newspaper in front of ___.
items.why: После предлога места — обычное местоимение: **in front of him**.

items.q: The soldiers dug a trench and hid ___ in it.
Nobody helped him; he built the shed ___.

exercises.title: Перепишите
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в конце.

items.prompt: Nobody helped me. I painted the room. Используйте: by myself
answers: I painted the room by myself.
I painted the room all by myself.

items.prompt: The president personally opened the bridge. Используйте: himself
answers: The president himself opened the bridge.
The president opened the bridge himself.

items.prompt: Tom hurt Tom while playing football. Замените повтор местоимением.
answers: Tom hurt himself while playing football.

items.prompt: Я сам починил велосипед. (fix / bike / myself)
answers: I fixed the bike by myself.
I fixed my bike by myself.
I repaired the bike by myself.
I repaired my bike by myself.

items.prompt: Исправьте: She put the bag next to herself.
answers: She put the bag next to her.

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите на английский. Ключевые слова даны.

answers: The door closed on its own.
The door shut on its own.

items.prompt: Он часто разговаривает сам с собой. (talk)

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями. Образцы — для самопроверки.

items.prompt: Is there anything you taught yourself? Say what.
items.sample: I taught myself to play the guitar.

items.prompt: Do you prefer to work by yourself or in a team? Why?
items.sample: I prefer to work by myself because I can concentrate better.

items.prompt: Have you ever been proud of yourself? When?
items.sample: Yes, I was proud of myself when I passed my driving test.

items.prompt: Describe something that happens by itself in your home (a light, a heater, a door ...).
items.sample: The lights in my hallway switch on by themselves when I come in.

items.prompt: Write about two people you know well, using each other.
items.sample: My parents have known each other for thirty years and still make each other laugh.
